name: FOLLOW MY VOICE
description: Bury a Town Card. Acquire a Drone.

name: GIVE IN
description: Bury a card in your discard pile. Acquire a Drone.

name: EYES EVERYWHERE
description: Draw three cards, discard two.

name: SCOUT
description: Acquire a Drone, OR, draw a card for every Drone in your play area.

name: HORDE
description: Acquire a Drone, OR, bury all Drones in your play area and inflict 2 suspicion for each.

name: DRONE
description: Draw a card.

name: DRONE
description: Draw a card.

name: SLAVES FOR CHEAP
description: Acquire a Drone. Acquire 1 Fear for every Drone in your play area.

name: UFO
description: Acquire 1 Fear.

name: CONSPIRACY THEORIST
description: Inflict 1 Suspicion.

name: THE GREAT AND POWERFUL
description: Discard all of your Fear. Inflict 1 suspicion for every 2 Fear discarded this way.

name: POWER WORD: CURSE
description: Name a number, roll the Magic Die. If you roll lower, self-inflict the named amount of suspicion. Otherwise, inflict the named amount.

name: POWER WORD: STRENGTH
description: Roll the Magic Die. Reveal a number of cards from the top of the deck equal to the die's value. You may or may not purchase one. Place the rest at the bottom of the deck.

name: POWER WORD: MISSILE
description: Discard the top card of your deck. Inflict suspicion equal to its cost.

name: INCESSANT CHANTING
description: Repeatedly roll the Magic Die, until you roll 3 or lower. Draw a card for every roll you did this way.

name: ARCANE ENCOUNTER
description: Acquire 1 Fear.

name: MAGIC TRICK
description: Inflict 1 Suspicion.

name: ALIGNING THE STARS
description: The next time you're tasked with rolling the Magic Die this turn, roll it twice, and use the higher result as the result of your roll.

name: TOIL AND TROUBLE
description: Roll the Magic Die. Acquire Fear equal to half the roll's value, rounded up.

name: INTRUDER
description: Reveal the top card of the Town deck, copy its effect, place it at the bottom of the Town Deck.

name: HARBRINGER OF DOOM
description: Inflict 1 Suspicion for every Mothman-associated card in the Town.

name: THE WOKE MOB
description: Your opponent reveals their hand. If they have no cards associated with your character, draw 2 cards.

name: AMBER ALERT
description: Inflict 1 Suspicion. Bury a Town Card.

name: BLINDING LIGHT
description: Bury a town card. You may continue to bury cards, as long as each successive card costs 1 Fear more than the previous. Inflict 1 suspicion for each card buried this way.

name: FOLLOW THE LIGHT
description: When this card is acquired, bury this card, and acquire the top 3 cards of the Town Deck.

name: WATCH THE GATES
description: Look at the top 3 cards of the Town deck. You may return them to the top or bottom of the deck in any order.

name: EYES IN THE DARK
description: Acquire 1 Fear.

name: TRICK OF THE LIGHT
description: Inflict 1 Suspicion.

name: SCOUT PREY
description: Copy the effect of a town card whose cost is 3 or less.

name: HESITANT NEW FACES
description: Acquire 1 Fear. You may bury a card from your hand to acquire 1 Fear.

name: MISSING CHILD
description: Acquire 1 Fear. If buried, inflict 2 suspicion.

name: CLOSE YOUR BLINDS
description: Bury this card, draw two cards.

name: PATROL ROUND
description: Draw a card. You may discard it to draw another.

name: NEGATIVITY BIAS
description: Inflict 1 Suspicion. If you already inflicted suspicion on the opponent this turn, inflict 1 more.

name: DESPERATE MEASURES
description: Self-inflict 1 Suspicion. Draw two cards.

name: DOOMSAYER
description: Acquire 3 Fear.

name: SCOPOPHOBIA
description: Copy your character card's ability without paying the associated suspicion cost.

name: HERD MENTALITY
description: Copy the effect of a card in your play area.

name: OCCULT ACTIVITY
description: Inflict 2 Suspicion.

name: PITCHFORKS AND TORCHES
description: For every two cards in your play area, including this one, inflict suspicion.

name: REVEL IN INFAMY
description: Acquire Fear equal to the Suspicion Meter's current value.

name: AS IT WAS WRITTEN
description: Inflict 2 suspicion. Place a card from your discard pile in your hand.

name: BLIND ADRENALINE
description: Draw three cards.

name: REIGN OF FEAR
description: Acquire a town card for free, and place it in your hand.

name: HYSTERIA
description: Inflict 4 suspicion.

name: INSATIABLE HUNGER
description: Acquire 1 Fear. Bury a card in your hand or discard pile.

name: DEAD WEIGHT
description: When this card is acquired, place it in the opponent's discard pile. Does nothing.

name: ERASE, REPLACE
description: Copy the effect of a card in your play area, then bury it.

name: BACK FOR SECONDS
description: Choose a card in the Graveyard. Copy its effect, then place it at the bottom of the Town Deck.

name: NO MAN'S LAND
description: Acquire 2 Fear. This turn you may buy a card from the graveyard as if it were a town card.

name: HOWLING WINDS
description: Acquire 1 Fear.

name: PLANTED EVIDENCE
description: Inflict 1 Suspicion.

name: AFTERTASTE
description: Copy the effect of a random card in the graveyard.

name: OLD HABITS
description: Inflict 1 Suspicion. If this card is buried, draw two cards.
